classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: Masters of the hold. Warriors earn bonus XP from staking and reduce Stash hold timers.

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: Seekers of hidden knowledge. Mages unlock extended lore and see deeper coin backstories.

classes.name: Merchant
classes.description: Deal-makers of the ecosystem. Merchants get pack discounts and trade bonuses.

classes.name: Explorer
classes.description: First to discover new coins. Explorers get early access to seasonal and edition coins.

classes.name: Collector
classes.description: Curators of the rarest cards. Collectors get enhanced Curator AI and inventory bonuses.
